findings.detail: public sympy polynomial algebra evaluates d at 4 without any guard firing and without the static allow-list noticing: sp.rem(num, d-4, d)/sp.rem(den, d-4, d), sp.resultant(., d-4, d), sp.compose(., 4, d) — all 4 probe expressions incl. the power-base case (toy/p22_bypass.json, p22_static.json). Poly.shift+as_coeff_add also bypasses the runtime guard (static scan catches it). Matrix.subs rename d->y bypasses on the power-base expression. Package itself contains no such call. These are high-level functions, not the disclosed Poly.rep/str residue; suggest guarding rem/div/prem/resultant/compose/shift (or Poly construction with d as generator from outside sympy) and adding them to VALUE_CALLS.

release_p22 accepts a P22_evanescent.json with calibration rho edited to 1 or coefficient_Kc_E2 edited to +1/16 (only flags/controls are checked). Mitigated: these values are in reference_values_p22 (entrypoint comparison would catch) and rerunning evanescent.py regenerates them; suggest checking the value keys typeset in the PDF against the live recomputation.

p22_conventions.py (which holds P22_PINNED_SHA256) and README are disclosed but not sha-pinned; an edit to p22_conventions alone is accepted. Pins are therefore only as strong as the tree/zip sha (the real anchor). By design, stated in the file.
release_p19/p20/p21 standalone accept all P22_evanescent and tools/notes edits (layer gates); release_p22 rejects them. Outside-block dred edits are rejected by every gate.
4D decoupling at every d is structural (gt on free indices), so 'stronger form' is true but carries little information beyond the definition of evanescent structures.

rho = 1/2 genuinely fixed on the 4D pair (2 consistent equations) and not refitted; the evanescent pair supplies one equation, so the test is one consistency relation. Sigma (S1, S2, SE) was taken from the P15_D13 certificate, not recomputed by me.

scope is honest where stated in full (one loop, kappa^2, two-point hh/K'.c/cb.c, MS-bar DRED with ev CTs, QdS externals; not higher points, two loops, bulk symmetry, O.1); the title line 'P.5 calculation renormalized at one loop kappa2' omits 'two-point functions / QdS externals', and the D11 ev CT normalisation is pinned by D11 pins, not closure (disclosed).
projected slot values (hh / K.c slots of the ev counterterms) and the trace-operator mutation were not independently recomputed.
